name: Glitch Pack
description: A digital-glitch toolkit: RGB-split titles in Anton, horizontal slice displacement, block noise in red and cyan, scanlines, a "SYSTEM REBOOT" terminal tag and glitch transitions that tear your footage apart and put it back together.
style: Edit overlay: RGB-split titles (red and cyan offsets), horizontal slice displacement, red/cyan/white block noise, scanlines every 3 px, dark vignette, mono system tags. Glitch is a seasoning — intense for intros and transitions, clean footage otherwise.
